Pumpkin Loaf
By: Moreen Wheatfield
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 5:33pm

Ingredients




3 cups of Flour
2 teaspoons baking powder
2 teaspoons baking soda
2 teaspoons cinnamon
1 tsp.salt
1 cup and ½  of mazola oil
2 cups of Pumpkin
2 cups white sugar
1 cup of raisins
4 eggs

Preparation

1 With the exception of the pumpkin and raisins, beat all other ingredients together and add pumpkin and raisins last. 2 Put in a loaf pan that has been lightly sprayed with cooking spray. Bake at 350 for 40 minutes

About


This is a very tasty loaf! Perfect with a nice cup of tea!
